# Rose Pine

Rose Pine applies a muted natural palette with pine tones and minimalist layouts. Three variants are available, Rosé Pine, Rosé Pine Moon and Rosé Pine Dawn, and the Style Settings plugin selects and customizes them.

![Rose Pine screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rose-pine/obsidian/HEAD/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Rose Pine"
    author: "rose-pine"
    repo:   "rose-pine/obsidian"
    slug:   "rose-pine"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/rose-pine"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/rose-pine/obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rose-pine/obsidian/HEAD/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a soft, muted Rosé Pine palette with natural pine tones, cozy faux-fur accents, and clean minimalist layouts for a subtle, stylish workspace. Choose between Rosé Pine, Rosé Pine Moon, and Rosé Pine Dawn, and customize variants via the Style Settings plugin."
}
```
